as_written_in_papers.quote: identified a heterozygous frameshift variant in LAMP2 (NM_002294.3: c.1079_1083delGAAAG), predicted to generate a premature termination codon (p.Gly360Valfs*11).

cases.statement: Two carriers in one family: the proband, a 27-year-old heterozygous woman with dilated cardiomyopathy and cardioembolic stroke; and her hemizygous son (phenotype not described).

people.label: proband (A 27-year-old woman)
people.key_phenotypes: right basal ganglia infarction (presumed cardioembolic); dilated cardiomyopathy with LVEF 21-30% and mid-wall late gadolinium enhancement; non-sustained ventricular tachycardia and frequent ectopy; elevated creatine kinase; listed for heart transplantation

quotes.quote: Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed diffusion restriction in the right basal ganglia, and magnetic resonance angiography showed distal right middle cerebral artery narrowing.

Laboratory testing showed creatine kinase 299.1 U/L (reference 105–245), urine protein 1+, and elevated N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide 1,677.9 pg/mL (reference < 100) with mildly increased cardiac troponin I 0.063 ug/L (reference < 0.026).

Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (March 22, 2019) revealed left ventricular dilation (end-diastolic diameter 66.8 × 59.0 mm), global systolic dysfunction (LVEF 21%), preserved right ventricular size with reduced function, and patchy mid-wall late gadolinium enhancement of the septal, anterior, lateral, and inferior walls (Figure 3).
1,584 premature ventricular contractions including 22 couplets, and two brief runs of non-sustained ventricular tachycardia
Sanger sequencing confirmed the heterozygous LAMP2 c.1079_1083delGAAAG (p.Gly360Valfs*11) deletion in the proband (Figure 4A).

people.label: son of proband
people.key_phenotypes: not reported (age not stated; the proband delivered him at age 21; the discussion mentions surveillance of 'asymptomatic carriers' without saying he is asymptomatic)

quotes.quote: Cascade testing demonstrated the hemizygous deletion in her son (Figure 4B)
She had delivered a son by cesarean section at age 21.
Detection of the same variant in the patient's son underscores the need for early surveillance in asymptomatic carriers.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Dilated cardiomyopathy with stroke as first presentation; authors note it differs from the classical hypertrophic form. Exome sequencing was done; rare variants in five other genes were found and judged by the authors as without phenotypic correlation. Patent foramen ovale and coronary disease were investigated.

quotes.quote: Additional rare variants detected in BBS1, DCHS1, VWF, RYR2, and CYP4V2 were interpreted as variants of uncertain significance without phenotypic correlation.

Whole-exome sequencing achieved a mean coverage of 132x with 99.4% of targeted bases at >=20x and identified a heterozygous frameshift variant in LAMP2 (NM_002294.3: c.1079_1083delGAAAG), predicted to generate a premature termination codon (p.Gly360Valfs*11).
our proband manifested a predominantly dilated cavity with relatively preserved septal thickness
Right heart contrast echocardiography under resting and Valsalva conditions revealed no right-to-left shunt, excluding patent foramen ovale or atrial septal defects (Figures 2C,D).

segregation.statement: One additional carrier: the proband's son is hemizygous (clinical status not reported). Mother, father and younger brother of the proband tested wild-type. No affected relative other than the proband is described.

quotes.quote: Cascade testing demonstrated the hemizygous deletion in her son (Figure 4B), whereas her mother, father, and younger brother retained wild-type alleles (Figures 4C–E).

de_novo.statement: Both parents tested by Sanger sequencing and were wild-type; parentage confirmation not reported. Authors say de novo or parental germline mosaicism.

quotes.quote: Conversely, the absence of the variant in both parents suggests a de novo event or parental germline mosaicism.
(C) Maternal chromatogram showing wild-type sequence across the locus. (D) Paternal chromatogram showing wild-type sequence.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: From the batch HGVS, c.1079_1083del is a 5-bp deletion causing a frameshift, predicted p.(Gly360ValfsTer11). Authors describe disease mechanism as loss of LAMP2 and say the variant truncates the luminal domain.

quotes.quote: The frameshift variant c.1079_1083delGAAAG truncates the luminal domain of LAMP2 and has not been previously reported in ClinVar or HGMD.
Danon disease arises from loss of LAMP2, a lysosomal membrane protein critical for autophagic flux and intracellular homeostasis (3).

population_data_in_papers.statement: Authors state absence from population datasets (not named) and that the variant was not previously reported in two variant databases.

quotes.quote: the loss-of-function mechanism, absence from population datasets, and segregation in the pedigree satisfied ACMG PVS1, PM2, and PM6 criteria, supporting likely pathogenicity.

authors_classification.statement: Testing laboratory initially reported uncertain significance; authors reclassified to likely pathogenic with PVS1, PM2, PM6.

quotes.quote: Although the commercial laboratory initially categorized the LAMP2 variant as uncertain significance, application of American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics criteria (PVS1, PM2, PM6) alongside the family segregation data supported reclassification to likely pathogenic.

concerns: The two identities (DANON-ID0299 proband, DANON-ID0300 son) are different people (mother and son), correctly kept apart.
The son's clinical status and age are not reported; he is a hemizygous male whose phenotype would be informative.

Authors cite 'segregation in the pedigree' in support, but the only other carrier is the proband's own son, whose phenotype is not described; the panel should weigh this as transmission to an offspring rather than co-segregation with disease.
Proband's parents both tested negative but parentage was not confirmed; authors also raise parental germline mosaicism.
Exome found rare variants in BBS1, DCHS1, VWF, RYR2 and CYP4V2 in the proband; authors judged them without phenotypic correlation.
The first reported presentation (stroke) is atypical; authors attribute it to cardioembolism.
notes_for_panel: Best-documented candidate in this batch: transcript stated, exome with Sanger confirmation, both parents tested wild-type, younger brother wild-type, hemizygous son.
